claim: Objects standing on counters and an altar's dressing decide what a room is read as; a bare bar reads as a sauna, a forge or a crypt. A small kit of one to three props a fixture is enough; printed matter barely registers.
evidence: Blind reviewer on Gravesend's town goods, 2026-11-18 (experiments/town-goods).
use: Give goods fixtures to stand on (back bar, racks, counters) and dress them first.
